goal: Navigate to http://www.amazon.in/ to complete the goal: You are testing whether an AI agent can complete a real customer journey on this website. Journey: Search for 'wireless earbuds under 2000'. Sort or filter so the lowest price shows first. Open the cheapest in-stock item that really matches. Pick a size or variant if asked. Add it to the cart and open the cart. Find coupons or offers on the product, cart or offers page, try them, and keep the one that saves the most. Then go to checkout and stop at the payment or sign-in page. Never pay, place an order, create an account, or press a final Send, Submit, Apply, Book or Confirm button. Stop at the first page that asks for payment details or a final confirmation, with that button visible. If a form needs details, type only fake test data: name 'Test Agent', email test@example.com, phone 9999999999. Close cookie banners and popups and continue. Do not sign in. If the site asks you to sign in, stop on that page and report it. Milestones in order: searched, sorted_by_price, product_opened, variant_selected, added_to_cart, coupon_applied, checkout_reached. Set furthest_milestone to the last one you truly completed. Set outcome to 'success' if you reached every milestone you were allowed to reach, 'partial' if some, otherwise 'failure'. Set blocker to the single main obstacle, or 'none', and explain it in blocker_detail. Fill item_name, item_price, coupon_code, discount and total when they apply.
